lines.text: العالمین قد تمت وکملت تسنیخ هذه الابواب بعون الله الملک الوهاب کاتبه
lines.en: the worlds. The copying of these chapters has been completed and perfected with the help of God, the King, the Bestower. Its writer

lines.text: الحروف اقل السادات سید محمد تقی ابن المرحوم المغفور
lines.en: of the letters is the least of the Sayyids, Sayyid Muhammad Taqi, son of the late, forgiven

lines.text: میرزا عبد السمیع الحسینی الموسوی الشیرازی

lines.en: on the 22nd of the month of Jumada al-Thaniyah 1244.

summary.headline: Colophon of Completion
summary.text: Colophon completing the copying of the chapters, written by Sayyid Muhammad Taqi, son of the late Mirza ʿAbd al-Samiʿ al-Husayni al-Musawi al-Shirazi, on 22 Jumada al-Thaniyah 1244 AH.
